en.short_description: FAA ground-school study, digital logbook, E6B, checklists and drone training.
en.description:
PilotEnRoute is a study and record-keeping companion for pilots and student pilots. It is a training tool for use on the ground — not an avionics or navigation product.

—— Study ——

FAA EDUCATION
Ground-school material organised by subject, with exams, flashcards and a debrief so you can see what you actually know rather than what you have read.

DRONE TRAINING
Part 107 material for remote pilots.

CAREER
Guidance on ratings and the path between them.

—— Tools ——

E6B
The flight computer, in your pocket.

FLIGHT PLANNER
Work through a plan on the ground, with fuel and weight considerations.

CHECKLISTS
Build and follow your own checklists.

AIRPORT AND CHARTS
Airport information and chart reference for study and briefing.

WEATHER
Live weather from public aviation sources, for situational awareness while planning.

—— Records ——

LOGBOOK
A digital logbook for your hours.

ENDORSEMENTS AND DOCUMENTS
Keep your endorsements and documents together, with a reminder before your medical expires.

—— No account required ——

Sign-in is optional. Tap "Continue as guest" and everything is available.

—— Read this before you fly ——

PilotEnRoute is NOT approved for navigation and must not be used as a primary or sole source for any flight operation. It is not an EFB replacement, not a substitute for official charts, official weather briefings, the AIM, or your POH/AFM, and it is not certified by the FAA or any aviation authority. Every figure in it is for study and planning only. Verify everything against official sources, and comply with all applicable regulations and with your instructor's guidance.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing PilotEnRoute.

PilotEnRoute is an aviation STUDY and record-keeping app, not a navigation or avionics product - the listing, the terms and the in-app disclaimer all say so. Sign-in is OPTIONAL: tap "Continue as guest" on the login screen and every feature is available. No demo account is needed.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and step through onboarding.
2. On the login screen tap "Continue as guest" - this is the intended review path and no account is required.
3. Open Education and start any subject, then take an exam and review the debrief.
4. Open Tools and use the E6B flight computer.
5. Open Logbook and add an entry, then open Endorsements and Documents.
6. Open Checklists and create a checklist.
7. Open Weather to see live conditions pulled from public aviation sources.
8. Notification reminders (daily quiz, medical expiry) use INEXACT alarms; the app requests no exact-alarm permission.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your logbook entries, endorsements, documents, checklists and study progress, held on your device. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: Public aviation weather and airport data sources. No server of our own is required for the app to function.
• Location: Used only to show weather and airports near you, while the app is in use. You can decline and search by identifier instead.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
